values.note: $10 a night for a single or double site; day use $10 per vehicle. Fee envelopes and collection box near the entrance.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-crestone-creek-campground ('Single and Double Site: $10 per night'; 'Day Use: $10 per vehicle per day'; 'Fee envelopes and a collection box are provided near the entrance.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Sites spaced far apart along 0.7 mile of North Crestone Creek among aspen, juniper and fir; one is a pull-through. No length limit is posted.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-crestone-creek-campground ('This rustic campground runs 0.7 mile up the mountain along North Crestone Creek and includes 13 first-come, first-served sites. One site is pull-through.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Bear-resistant food locker at every site (food only, not trash).

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-crestone-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; 'Every site has a secure, bear-resistant food locker'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 2026 season May 15 (the conditions line says May 11) to November 18. The forest road beyond (FR 950) is closed Nov 25 - May 1.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-crestone-creek-campground ('Seasons of Use: Open May 15th to November 18th, 2026.'; 'Campground is open for the 2026 season from May 11th to November 18th.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/alerts/forest-road-950-n-crestone-closure (RG-94-14, FSR 950 closed November 25 to May 1 annually), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Best chance at a site is a weekday (Monday-Friday) morning.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-crestone-creek-campground ('First come, first served. The best time to secure sites is Monday through Friday mornings.'; '14-day camping limit.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Senior and Access passes: 50% off a single campsite, only the site the pass holder occupies.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-crestone-creek-campground ('Interagency Senior/Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites ONLY.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Rio Grande NF (Saguache Ranger District) rustic campground strung up the canyon along North Crestone Creek at ~8,300 ft, 1.3 mi north of Crestone on Alder Street; quiet, widely spaced sites. Camping is not allowed at the North Crestone Trailhead. --Claude
